Down the ropes they climbed into the abyssal darkness of a void long swallowed by the Earth. The only light shone from above like a beacon from Heaven itself, but it barely illuminated the entire cavern. Still, the promise of adventure or maybe even the thought of treasure forged their minds to continue until their feet hit the rocks of the bottom.

It wouldn't be more than ten meters past the landing that the surrounding would be dark; the only light now completely behind you. Fifty more meters and the winds and weaves of the rock would make it so that there was an impenetrable wall separating them from the sky light. Deeper into the belly of the beast they continue, their torches meandering ahead in search of discovery.

The air grew colder as they descended, and as it grew colder it also grew quieter. The sounds of the surface soon completely disappear, replaced only by the echoes of their footprints and the odd trickle of water. If they stood still and quiet, they could even hear their own hearts beating in their chests. Onward they continued into the inky fog in their quest for discovery.

Two hours of trudging through the dark they find light ahead. The path had never branched, forked, or diverged. It was never an option which way was forward or which way was back. So they rush forward to the light, only to quickly realize they have circled around to where they started. They looked up at the dangling ropes descending from the ceiling, and nodded silently in agreement: this Minecraft shaders mod is just too awesome.
